nodes.label: Test Writer Agent
nodes.description: Claude Code agent generating JUnit 5/Mockito/MockMvc tests for Spring Boot multi-tenant services, controllers, and repositories.

nodes.label: /build Command
nodes.description: Claude Code command running Maven clean package skipping tests.

nodes.label: /db-start Command
nodes.description: Claude Code command starting PostgreSQL via Docker Compose.

nodes.label: /deploy Command
nodes.description: Claude Code command for deployment workflow to staging or production.

nodes.label: /fix-issue Command
nodes.description: Claude Code command to investigate and fix a reported bug.

nodes.label: /new-feature Command
nodes.description: Scaffolds complete CRUD: entity, DTOs, mapper, repository, service, controller, Flyway migration.

nodes.label: /new-migration Command
nodes.description: Creates a versioned Flyway migration file in common or tenant directory.

nodes.label: /review-tenant-isolation Command
nodes.description: Audits for tenant isolation leaks: SET search_path, missing TenantContext.clear(), cross-tenant queries.

nodes.label: /review Command
nodes.description: Thorough code review checking all project rules for style, security, and test coverage.

nodes.label: /test Command
nodes.description: Runs full Maven test suite and summarizes results.

nodes.label: API Conventions Rule
nodes.description: REST API conventions: URL structure, HTTP codes, pagination format, error responses, endpoint security.

nodes.label: Code Style Rule
nodes.description: Java/Spring Boot code style: Lombok, naming conventions, class structure, JPA, DTOs, SQL migrations.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy Rule
nodes.description: Non-negotiable rules for tenant isolation: TenantContext usage, schema naming, JWT claims, provisioning order.

nodes.label: Testing Strategy Rule
nodes.description: Test strategy: real PostgreSQL via Testcontainers, unit/integration/controller/isolation test types, 80% coverage targets.

nodes.label: Deploy Skill (Backend)
nodes.description: Skill for deploying locally via Maven and Docker, or to production with env var configuration.

nodes.label: Security Review Skill (Backend)
nodes.description: Skill for quick or full security audit, delegating to security-auditor agent for deep analysis.

nodes.label: Spring Boot Application (Sub-project)
nodes.description: Spring Boot 4.0.5 SaaS stock management with schema-based multi-tenancy, PostgreSQL, Flyway.

nodes.label: TenantContext (Sub-project)
nodes.description: ThreadLocal holder for current tenant/schema, always cleared in finally block.

nodes.label: TenantSchemaResolver
nodes.description: Resolves JWT tenant claim to PostgreSQL schema name with caching.

nodes.label: CurrentTenantIdentifierResolverImpl
nodes.description: Hibernate hook providing current schema name from TenantContext.

nodes.label: MultiTenantConnectionProviderImpl
nodes.description: Hibernate hook switching database connection schema via SET search_path.

nodes.label: ProvisioningServiceImpl (Sub-project)
nodes.description: Creates PostgreSQL schema and runs Flyway migrations on tenant approval.

nodes.label: JwtAuthenticationFilter (Sub-project)
nodes.description: Spring Security filter extracting and validating JWT, storing tenantId in TenantContext.

nodes.label: Flyway Migrations (Sub-project)
nodes.description: Versioned SQL migrations in db/migration/common and db/migration/tenant.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.description: PostgreSQL 17 in Docker providing schema-based multi-tenancy.

nodes.label: Schema-Based Multi-Tenancy
nodes.description: Each tenant has isolated PostgreSQL schema schema_<companyCode>, provisioned on approval.

nodes.label: Docker Compose (Sub-project)
nodes.description: Docker Compose defining PostgreSQL service (saas-db) with persistent volume.

nodes.label: application.yml
nodes.description: Spring Boot config: datasource, JPA SCHEMA multi-tenancy, Flyway common migrations, JWT key paths, SpringDoc.

nodes.label: SpringDoc OpenAPI
nodes.description: SpringDoc OpenAPI 3.0.2 with Swagger UI at localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html.

nodes.label: Lombok
nodes.description: Java code generation: @Data, @Builder, @RequiredArgsConstructor, @Slf4j.

nodes.label: Testcontainers
nodes.description: Real PostgreSQL containers for integration tests, not mocks.

nodes.label: Tenant Lifecycle
nodes.description: PENDING→ACTIVE (via approve/provision)→SUSPENDED or INACTIVE lifecycle.

nodes.label: Platform Admin
nodes.description: Global admin with ROLE_PLATFORM_ADMIN managing all tenants, no tenant_id, operates on public schema.

nodes.label: Company Admin
nodes.description: First tenant user with ROLE_COMPANY_ADMIN, scoped to their tenant schema.

nodes.label: POST /auth/register
nodes.description: Public endpoint registering a new tenant with PENDING status.

nodes.label: POST /auth/login
nodes.description: Public endpoint authenticating users and returning JWT with role and tenant_id claims.

nodes.label: POST /tenants/approve/{id}
nodes.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN endpoint provisioning tenant schema, Flyway migrations, and creating COMPANY_ADMIN.

nodes.label: HikariCP Connection Pool
nodes.description: Connection pool configured with max 10, min 5 idle connections.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.description: Entities never physically deleted, marked with deleted=true to preserve audit history.

nodes.label: OWASP Top 10
nodes.description: Security risk framework covering broken access control, injection, authentication failures.

nodes.label: ThreadLocal Leak
nodes.description: Risk: TenantContext not cleared after request, leaking tenant to subsequent requests.

nodes.label: SecurityConfig
nodes.description: Spring Security config defining public endpoints (permitAll) and role-based access control.
